Usage

When to use. Surface secondary content next to a trigger without leaving the page — hints, quick actions, small forms, or detail on demand. The beak ties the surface to its anchor; place it on the side with the most room.

Do

  • Point the beak at the element that opened the popover.
  • Flip position (Above/Below/Left/Right) to stay within the viewport.
  • Dismiss on outside click or Esc.
  • Keep content compact — it is a companion, not a page.

Don't

  • Use it for critical, blocking decisions — use a Dialog.
  • Nest popovers or stack multiple open at once.
  • Detach the beak from the trigger.
  • Overflow the viewport instead of repositioning.
